timeline.summary: On 23 April 2026, HDFC Life said HDFC Bank's stake would be 50.27% after the proposed preferential issue of 1,45,23,906 shares, on a fully diluted base of 2,18,39,50,540 shares.
On 16 April 2026, HDFC Life's FY26 earnings call reported VNB of ₹4,034 Cr (+2% YoY) and a margin of 24.2%, down 140 bps, with the board approving a ₹1,000 Cr preferential issue to HDFC Bank.

On 18 May 2026, HDFC Life said shareholders passed by postal ballot the special resolution to issue 1,45,23,906 equity shares on a preferential basis to promoter HDFC Bank, with 99.9981% of votes polled in favour; allotment awaits regulatory approvals.
HDFC Life cancels its June 1, 2026, Bank of America’s Flagship India Conference Group meet in Mumbai due to Nagesh Pai’s digital signature.
Q1FY27 (Jul 15, 2026): HDFC Life reported PAT of ₹611 Cr; on net premium of ₹16,548 Cr; solvency ratio eased to 185% from 192%.
Q1FY27 (Jul 15, 2026): HDFC Life reported VNB of ₹879 Cr (+9%), new business margin of 25.0% (25.6% ex-GST), PAT of ₹611 Cr (+12%) and solvency of 185%, with bancassurance APE flat YoY.
HDFC Life held its 26th AGM on July 16, 2026; all resolutions passed including dividend declaration and auditor appointment

August 19, 2026: HDFC Life receives IRDAI approval for re-appointment of Ms Vibha Padalkar as MD & CEO (effective September 12, 2026) and Mr Niraj Shah as Executive Director & CFO (effective April 26, 2026)
On September 10, 2026, HDFC Life received Appeal Order confirming GST demand of ₹2,423 Cr including interest and penalty for FY18-FY22 period, to be contested before GST Appellate Tribunal.
HDFC Life reported in Q2 PAT at ₹508 Cr and approved a ₹500 Cr NCD issue and a new GIFT City office.
October 15, 2026: HDFC Life reported H1FY27 VNB of ₹2,037 Cr (+12% YoY), APE of ₹8,245 Cr (+11%), PAT of ₹1,119 Cr (+13%) and new business margin of 24.7%.
Audio recording of earnings call for quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026 hosted on company website on October 15, 2026.
HDFC Life reported H1FY27 VNB of ₹2,037 Cr, up 12% YoY, and announced a ₹500 Cr subordinated debt raise.
